en.title: Three-Digit Numbers with Three Distinct Digits
en.description:
Given a closed range [left,right], count the three-digit integers in it whose hundreds, tens, and ones digits are pairwise different. The original site's answer of 5 for 476..979 is wrong, so this site uses an example recomputed from the definition.

The input format, examples, and test data were compiled and written by CSWork.
en.output: Output the answer as described; separate multiple results with spaces in order, and output an empty line for an empty array.
en.explanation: Example 1: checking each three-digit number from 476 to 979, there are 371 integers whose digits are pairwise different; for example, 476 is valid and 477 is not.
hints: Iterate over the range, convert each number into its three digit characters, and count it if the set has size 3.
